authority: G4-07 SRC-22 COL-NET, D0 read only 16MiB, 2048 entries, 4s; local interface sysfs only; no packets/writes/credentials

Accepted G5-03 passive_worker.py SRC-22 ROOTS/ATTRS, source_paths ordinal binding

path.interface_name: [a-zA-Z0-9_.:-]+, not hidden/dot; lexical sorted directory names
path.source_paths: Only successful reads in the exact worker path and fixed attribute order. Missing optional attrs reported separately. itemNNNN binds to source_paths index, then SHA-256 original bytes.

private_data: The link-layer address may be identifying information; private canonical only, to be processed through later owner-approved G5-05 per-datum privacy.yaml and G5-06 publication masking. Do NOT display paths/addresses from original evidence in generated public reports.

interpretation.address: bounded single-line textual link-layer address, preserve original and normalized trimmed text, do NOT assert a MAC type or reveal publicly
interpretation.operstate: bounded single-line link state label as text, preserve novel labels, no live connectivity/packet assertions
interpretation.carrier: strict 0/1 boolean if present; expected optional absence supported by G5-03 worker
interpretation.speed: positive/nonnegative numeric Mb/s; -1 (Linux unknown sentinel) -> explicit object {known:false,reported_code:-1}, not a measured link speed
interpretation.type: nonnegative decimal ARPHRD link type numeric code only, no interface kind inference
interpretation.duplex: bounded single-line full/half/unknown string; never infer throughput
interpretation.ifindex: positive decimal integer, interface index not a global stable identifier

tests.oracle: two synthetic interfaces valid worker lexical order; sealed 1:1 original evidence, true booleans, MTU bytes and ifindex
speed 1000 yields integer Mb/s; -1 yields an explicit unknown sentinel OBJECT, not a measured negative throughput
optional carrier/speed/duplex unavailable fields not fabricated; source absent doesn't invent interfaces
path count mismatch, duplicate, scrambled attr order or name sort, forged item ordinal all reject before manifest
path traversal, wrong root, hidden dot name, unregistered interface attribute like wireless or statistics, malicious credential path reject
cross-run original, mismatched sealed SHA256, abnormal type and malformed UTF-8 fall back or reject without original edits
invalid numeric/boolean/negative speed other than -1, multiline, oversized scalar -> actual parser failure + original evidence
new/unfamiliar operstate and non-ethernet link-layer address preserved as string without falsely asserting connectivity or MAC type

provenance: Test oracle derived from approved G4/G5 worker/source contracts before parser code. Same AI does separate pass; NOT independent human review. Current CI tests are synthetic fixtures; no host packet capture.
completion_limits: Scoped CI success only, no full CP03 completion/CP04 closure/CP05 acceptance/CP06 Bodhi or gate CP07 acceptance.
